name: Git
description: Branch, commit, PR, and history workflows with safe defaults.

name: UEFN
description: Unreal Editor for Fortnite + Verse device scripting and live-edit workflows.
mcpNote: Needs the UEFN bridge MCP for live-editor control (uefn_* tools); without it this skill only covers Verse/device authoring.

name: Playwright
description: Browser automation, UI QA, screenshots, and accessibility checks.
mcpNote: Pairs with the Playwright MCP server (MCP tab) to actually drive a browser.

name: Godot
description: Godot 4 GDScript nodes, scenes, signals, and game systems.
mcpNote: More effective with a Godot editor MCP for live scene/node inspection.

name: Unity
description: Unity C# MonoBehaviour components, prefabs, and scene workflows.
mcpNote: More effective with a Unity editor MCP for live scene/asset control.

name: Roblox
description: Roblox Studio + Luau scripting — instances, services, and experience workflows.
mcpNote: Needs the Roblox Studio MCP (MCP tab) to read your data model and run Luau in a live Studio session.

name: Unreal Engine
description: Unreal Engine C++/Blueprint gameplay, actors, and editor workflows.

name: Three.js
description: Three.js scenes, meshes, lighting, and render-loop lifecycle.

name: Graphify
description: Turn a codebase (plus docs, PDFs, images) into a queryable knowledge graph to map architecture and answer how-does-this-connect questions.
mcpNote: Pairs with the search-retrieval agent; parses code offline, uses your configured LLM for semantic extraction. Also ships an MCP mode.

name: Understand Anything
description: Generate an interactive, browsable knowledge-graph dashboard of any codebase — great for onboarding non-coders to complex systems.
mcpNote: Great alongside the UEFN / Godot / Unity packs for exploring engine projects visually. Supports local models (Ollama) for privacy.

name: Frontend Design
description: Anthropic's skill for distinctive, production-grade UI that avoids generic AI aesthetics — bold typography, color, motion, and layout.

name: Taste
description: Upgrades AI-built interfaces with better layout, typography, motion, and spacing to avoid generic slop — framework-agnostic.
mcpNote: Complements Frontend Design; pairs with the ux-ui-designer agent.

name: Stop Slop
description: Strips characteristic AI writing patterns (cliches, filler, rhetorical tics) so generated prose reads as authentically human.
mcpNote: Great for READMEs, docs, and release notes. Local, no network.

name: Remotion
description: Create videos programmatically in React — trailers, demos, and automated video from code.
mcpNote: Standalone npm library. Overlaps with HyperFrames (React vs HTML/CSS).

name: HyperFrames
description: Render HTML/CSS/animations into deterministic MP4 videos (headless Chrome + FFmpeg) — demos, social, automated video pipelines.
mcpNote: Standalone library; needs Node 22+ and FFmpeg. Overlaps with Remotion (HTML/CSS vs React).
